barlow_exact_upgrade.scope: Any legal bi-infinite ideal close-packed triangular-layer Barlow stacking with uniform 12-neighbor NN walk
barlow_exact_upgrade.gauge_proof: Each layer edge hopping equals beta times a phase. The layer graph is the line Z and has no cycle flux. With u_0=1, define u_{n+1} recursively so the diagonal layer gauge removes each edge phase. At beta=0 the hopping is already zero. Every basal fiber is therefore unitarily equivalent to alpha*I+beta*(S+S*).
barlow_exact_upgrade.root_preservation: u_0=1 preserves the root layer vector

barlow_exact_upgrade.nonconsequence: The q-dependent gauge is not a physical-coordinate vertex permutation and does not erase wavevector-labelled angular dispersion or physical-coordinate heat-kernel corrections.
barlow_exact_upgrade.ids_boundary: A finite-volume/exhaustion IDS statement requires the chosen standard boundary/Folner convention; infinite-operator and root-local spectral equivalence do not require periodicity.
